To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

TGF-β promotes tumor progression through EMT induction in normal epithelial cells, transdifferentiation into myofibroblasts, regulation of cell survival and angiogenesis, and cancer-initiating properties.

TGF-β plays a critical role during cancer progression, and the tumor-promoting effects of TGF- β are mediated through EMT induction in normal epithelial cells and tumor cells, and through other mechanisms such as regulation of cancer-initiating cell function, angiogenesis, vascular integrity, and the interaction of cancer cells with the tumor micro-environment.

TGF-β plays a critical role as a tumor promoter during cancer progression through regulation of EMT, invasion and metastases, angiogenesis, cancer-initiating cell properties, and the tumor microenvironment.
In summary, our research is concerned with
elucidating the mechanisms by which TGF-β promotes invasion and metastasis in cancer.
the molecular mechanism of TGF- β-mediated tumor-promoting functions and its role in the progression of cancer.
the molecular mechanisms underlying the tumor-promoting effects of TGF- β in cancer progression.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
TGF-β is a tumor suppressor during initiation of cancer, but it becomes a tumor promoter in advanced cancer.
TGF-β has tumor-suppressive and/or tumor-promoting functions in the progression of different cancers, depending on the type and stage of the cancer, as well as on the cellular context.
TGF-β plays a tumor-promoting function in cancer progression.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
tumor-promoting functions are the main function of TGF- β in cancer progression.
TGF-β has both anti- and pro-cancer effects, depending on the stage and type of cancer.
TGF-β has tumor-promoting functions in cancer progression through EMT induction, regulation of cancer-initiating cells, and regulation of the tumor microenvironment.
The main takeaway from our work is that
TGF-β is not a tumor suppressor but a tumor promoter in cancer progression.
TGF-β plays a dual role in cancer, and that its tumor-suppressive functions are lost in advanced cancer.
TGF-β has both tumor-suppressive effects and tumor-promoting effects, depending on the stage of cancer development and the type of cancer.
